slides.headline: what to say when they didn’t get the promotion
don’t open with filler
slides.sub: skip “this is hard” and “you were so close.” start clear so they don’t have to guess.

slides.headline: say the answer first
slides.sub: “you’re not being promoted this round.” then stop. let the room be quiet for a beat.

slides.headline: name the gap you can see
slides.sub: “i need to see you lead work through other people, not just do it all yourself.”

slides.headline: give one next step, not a blur
slides.sub: “for the next few weeks, i want you to hand off the weekly update and coach it through.”

slides.headline: what part of this talk do you put off?
slides.sub: say the first line you’re stuck on

caption:
if you wait too long, they make up their own answer and it’s usually harsher than yours. say the kind thing out loud.

save this for the review talk you keep putting off.
